reason: V0.4.3 and V0.4.3A failed to identify historical Hyperliquid semantics from fundingHistory API rows. This amendment does not relax those probes. It switches provenance to Hyperliquid's official requester-pays asset_ctx archive, where the per-minute funding/premium/mark/oracle context is directly published, and separately audits calendar completeness.

stage_A_semantics.purpose: Reproduce source-field semantics from official archive before paying for the full calendar sweep.
stage_A_semantics.progression_rule: Stage B is authorized only if Stage A semantic gate passes. This stopping rule depends only on source semantics/provenance, never on carry, basis, PnL or asset performance.

stage_B_calendar_coverage.purpose: Audit every candidate UTC day for BTC/ETH structural and settlement-reference completeness.
stage_B_calendar_coverage.known_prior_2024-09-01_rule: If seeded, its exact reported hashes and structural counts must match the exposure ledger. Do not invent economic fields.

semantic_probe_freeze.premium_validity_rule: Use a row only when impact_bid_px > 0 and impact_ask_px > 0; a literal premium of zero is allowed and is not missing by itself.

coverage_freeze.full_day_rule: For each of BTC and ETH: exactly 1440 distinct minute buckets plus 24 unique exact top-of-hour rows with positive mark_px and oracle_px, and no structural failure.
coverage_freeze.full_month_rule: Every calendar day in that UTC month must be a full day for BOTH BTC and ETH. One failed or unavailable day fails the month.
coverage_freeze.common_month_rule: Month is eligible only when BOTH BTC and ETH pass the full_month_rule.

economic_claim_boundary.reason: Symmetric audit-grade historical execution/fill data remain unavailable under G07. Passing V0.4.4 can authorize only a separately frozen mechanism replication / pre-slippage economics stage, never a claim of exact executable historical return.

post_v044_rule.if_stage_A_fails: STOP historical archive semantic path as DATA_INADEQUATE_OR_SEMANTICS_UNRESOLVED. Do not rescue by changing thresholds, panel, formula, windows or tolerance.
post_v044_rule.if_stage_A_passes_and_stage_B_finds_comm: Materialize G04/G10 calendar from coverage only, then freeze the economic mechanism-replication contract before any new economic output is opened.
post_v044_rule.if_stage_B_has_zero_common_months: Classify DATA_INADEQUATE and stop historical mechanism replication.
post_v044_rule.contaminated_boundary_rule: Any mechanism result using the previously viewed 2024-09-01 / 2025-12-31 boundary prices must be labeled contaminated/adversarial replication rather than virgin Discovery.
